notes: Budgets for backend/runner/src/terminals/manager.ts: scripts/ratchet/manager.test.ts fails when the file grows past one, and a raise goes only as far as the file needs, never leaving headroom. Set from main at a1fbfdaf (2026-10-17).

slack is how far under its budget the file may sit before the budget must come down. A change that removes a little passes and the test prints the number the budget could be lowered to, so everyday product work never edits this file (about a third of main's commits touch manager.ts, and concurrent pull requests would conflict here). Past the slack, as after an extraction, the test fails until the budget is lowered (in a change that touches manager.ts or this file; any other change only prints it, as two changes merged one after the other can leave the file past a budget neither crossed alone), so a large win is locked in. Lowering a slack needs nothing; raising one is written as a raised budget is, with why and where from.

lines counts the file's lines. methods counts every function the Terminals class defines in its body: methods, accessors, the constructor and properties set to a function or arrow expression, read from its syntax tree, so formatting never moves it.

New behaviour goes in a sibling module under backend/runner/src/terminals/, as closes.ts, opens.ts and naming.ts do, with the class calling it. Work that can't is raised in the same pull request, written { "budget": n, "reason": "why", "from": "#PR or commit" }.

lines.reason: Transcript redaction: three Terminals options (transcriptMs, transcriptShutdownMs, redactor) with their Omit entries, the redactor's construction, the restart's save once the earlier screen is shown, and the restore's once its replay ends; the rest is in saving.ts. Transcript sealing: two more options (sealer, transcriptKeyMs) with their Omit entries and construction, and the restore's open before the shell starts, less the re-save once restored, which sealing makes redundant. Inbox turn rows (+3): Bindings and murmur reach Asks and the redactor, so the redactor is a local shared with Saves, plus the Bindings host's turns entry and murmur's clearGists.
